sources.quote: Two-layer graph convolution with symmetric normalization reaches 0.718 macro-F1 under degree shift.
Observed macro-F1 is 0.752 for the scaled two-layer model and 0.718 for the baseline across 5 fixed seeds.

methods.name: Two-layer GCN with degree scaling
methods.exact_change: Combines a standard two-layer GCN with one degree-aware L2 scaling parameter.
methods.simplest_alternative: Two-layer GCN with symmetric normalization (0.718 macro-F1 across 5 fixed seeds).
methods.ablation_evidence: Removing degree-aware L2 scaling drops macro-F1 from 0.752 to 0.718 (-0.034) on identical splits.

component_justifications.Degree-aware L2 scaling: Adds +0.034 macro-F1 (0.718 to 0.752) across 5 fixed seeds.
